words.tr: 为……付出代价：因某种行为或决定而遭受不良后果或惩罚。
words.ex: He had to pay the price for his reckless actions.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不为他的鲁莽行为付出代价。
words.en: To suffer the consequences of something.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；参与
words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事物与另一事物联系起来
words.ex: He associates math with hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把数学与努力联系在一起。
words.en: To link or connect one idea, thing, or person with another in one's mind.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr: phrase. 提供对……的访问；使能够使用；使能够进入
words.ex: The school will provide access to the library for all students.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为所有学生提供图书馆的访问权限。
words.en: To make something available for use or entry.

words.tr: phrase. 与…背道而驰；与…相抵触；违背
words.ex: His opinion runs counter to the teacher's.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与老师的相反。
words.en: If one thing runs counter to another, it is very different from it and seems to conflict with it.

words.w: take a risk of doing sth
words.tr: phrase. 冒险做某事；甘冒……的风险
words.uk: teɪk ə rɪsk əv ˈdʊɪŋ sth
words.us: teɪk ə rɪsk əv ˈduːɪŋ sth
words.ex: He took a risk of quitting his job to start a business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒险辞掉了工作去创业。
words.en: To do something despite the possibility of failure, loss, or danger.

words.tr: phrase. 提供对……的新见解；为……带来全新的认识
words.ex: This study provides new insights into how children learn math.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究为儿童如何学习数学提供了新的见解。
words.en: To offer fresh, original, or deeper understanding of a subject or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 与……有联系；与……有关联
words.ex: He has a connection with the local artist.
words.ex_cn: 他与当地艺术家有联系。
words.en: To have a relationship or link with someone or something, often based on shared interests or experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 对…采取行动；着手处理
words.ex: The government must take action on pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府必须对污染采取行动。
words.en: To begin to deal with or address a problem or situation.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 未能达到；不足；不够
words.ex: He fell short of the target score.
words.ex_cn: 他没能达到目标分数。
words.en: To not reach the standard or level that is expected or required.

words.tr: v. 在……与……之间进行比较；对……和……进行对比
words.ex: Students make comparisons between and apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 学生在苹果和橙子之间进行比较。
words.en: To examine the similarities and differences between two or more things.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有影响；对…起作用；产生效果
words.ex: Smoking has an impact on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有影响。
words.en: To have a significant effect on someone or something.

words.tr: v. 对……产生影响；对……起作用
words.ex: Pollution have an impacts upon the environment.
words.ex_cn: 污染对环境产生影响。
words.en: To have a significant effect or influence on something.

words.tr: phrase. 参与；参加
words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.tr: phrase. 把……归咎于；责怪某人承担过错
words.ex: He blames his failure on bad luck.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的失败归咎于坏运气。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, or if you blame something bad on somebody, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；取决于
words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. 有关；涉及
words.ex: This story relates to childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与童年的回忆有关。
words.en: If you relate to someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings or ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 由...组成
words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr: 短语动词. 反对……开展运动；为反对……而进行宣传或斗争
words.ex: They started a campaign against pollution.
words.ex_cn: 他们发起了反对污染的运动。
words.en: To actively oppose or argue against a particular cause or candidate.

words.tr: phrase. 与……合作；与……协作
words.ex: They collaborate with their classmates on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们和同学一起合作做作业。
words.en: Work jointly with someone or a group to achieve a common goal.

words.tr: v. 与他人合作完成（某事）；在（某项目、计划等）上协作
words.ex: They collaborate on a science project.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作进行一个科学项目。
words.en: To work jointly on an activity or project.

words.tr: phrase. 把…带到；导致；通向
words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.w: not to put too fine a point on it
words.tr: adv. 直截了当地说；不客气地说；说白了
words.uk: nɒt tə pʊt tuː faɪn ə pɔɪnt ɒn ɪt
words.us: nɑːt tə pʊt tuː faɪn ə pɔɪnt ɑːn ɪt
words.ex: Not to put too fine a point on it, you are late again.
words.ex_cn: 直说吧，你又迟到了。
words.en: To speak frankly; to be blunt or direct.

words.tr: v. 区分……和……；辨别……与……之间的不同
words.ex: He can distinguish between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他能分清对与错。
words.en: To recognize or show the difference between two or more things.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖；依靠
words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；搬离；逐渐放弃；摆脱
words.ex: He wants to move away from the noisy city.
words.ex_cn: 他想离开这个嘈杂的城市。
words.en: To stop doing or using something, or to change from one thing to another.

words.tr: phrase. 由…起源；来自
words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: To obtain something from a specified source.

words.tr: phrase. 绑定到；与……结合
words.ex: The glue will bind to the paper tightly.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会紧紧地粘在纸上。
words.en: To associate or link something closely to something else, often in a way that is difficult to separate.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 深入探究；深入研究
words.ex: He delves into ancient history books.
words.ex_cn: 他深入钻研古代历史书籍。
words.en: To delve into something means to try to discover new information about it or to examine it in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 与……相适应；与……协调；融入
words.ex: He tried to fit in with the new group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新团体。
words.en: To be accepted by or to belong to a particular group or to be in harmony with something.

words.tr: phrase. 带来；引起
words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑；处理；正视；对付
words.ex: We need to reckon with the possibility of delays.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要考虑到可能的延迟。
words.en: To consider or deal with something or someone as an important factor in a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 与…分享；与…分担
words.ex: I will share the book with my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我会和我的朋友分享这本书。
words.en: To give a portion of something to someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 关注；涉及；关心；与…有关
words.ex: Parents are often concerned with their children's education.
words.ex_cn: 父母通常关注孩子的教育。
words.en: to be about or relate to a particular subject or issue

words.tr: phrase. 将A与B分开；把A从B中分离出来
words.ex: He must separate a from b to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他必须把a和b分开来解决问题。
words.en: To divide or isolate one thing or person from another, creating a distinct boundary or space between them.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于；始于（某一时期）
words.ex: These old coins date from the year 1800.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧硬币可以追溯到1800年。
words.en: If something dates from a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.tr: v. 将 a 与 b 进行比较，以找出差异或评估优劣
words.ex: He compares a against b to find the difference.
words.ex_cn: 他把a和b进行比较以找出差异。
words.en: To examine the similarities and differences between two things, often to evaluate them.

words.tr: phrase. 妨碍…；打搅…
words.ex: Don't interfere with my work.
words.ex_cn: 不要干涉我的工作。
words.en: To interfere with something means to prevent it from happening or developing as it should, often by causing a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 属于
words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: phrase. 不同
words.ex: This apple differs from that one in color.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个苹果在颜色上不同。
words.en: to be not the same as something else

words.tr: phrase. 使协调；使一致；使调和（常指使思想、情感或行为与某人或某事物保持一致）
words.ex: He tries to attune to the rhythm of the music.
words.ex_cn: 他试图适应音乐的节奏。
words.en: To become familiar with or responsive to something.

words.tr: phr. 引导穿过；带领通过；指导完成
words.ex: He leads through the dark tunnel with a flashlight.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒带领大家穿过黑暗的隧道。
words.en: To guide or direct someone or something through a process or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；着手
words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 延期；推迟
words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: vt. 将图案或文字压印在……上；使浮现在……上
words.ex: He embosses his name on the leather journal.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字压印在皮质笔记本上。
words.en: To impress or stamp a design or pattern onto a surface.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于；参加
words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: To participate or become involved in an activity.

words.tr: phrase. 充当；担任；担当
words.ex: Please act as a guide for the visitors.
words.ex_cn: 请为来访者充当向导。
words.en: To function or serve in a particular role or capacity.

words.tr: v. 把……归因于；认为……是……的结果
words.ex: He attributes his success in life to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把人生的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: To assign a quality, characteristic, or cause to something.

words.tr: phrase. 专心阅读；钻研
words.ex: He pores over his math book every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都仔细研读他的数学书。
words.en: If you pore over or through information, you look at it and study it very carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于；向某一点会合或聚集
words.ex: Crowds of people converge on the city center for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人群为庆祝节日聚集在市中心。
words.en: To move towards the same point and come together from different directions; to tend towards a common conclusion or result.

words.tr: phrase. 更喜欢；宁愿；宁可
words.ex: I prefer to walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢走路去学校。
words.en: To like or choose one thing over another.

words.tr: phrase. 执行；进行；履行
words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr: phrase. 分成；除尽
words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate or split something into parts or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 适应
words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 想起；想到
words.ex: It did not occur to him to call for help.
words.ex_cn: 他没想到要打电话求助。
words.en: If a thought or idea occurs to you, it comes into your mind.

words.tr: phrase. 对…感到困惑；苦苦思索；为…伤脑筋
words.ex: I puzzle about why the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 我一直在思考为什么天空是蓝色的。
words.en: To think deeply about something in order to understand or solve it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 抚养；提出；呕吐
words.ex: She brought up her children with love.
words.ex_cn: 她用爱抚养了她的孩子们。
words.en: To bring something to a place or person, often as a gift or offering.

words.tr: v. 概括；总结……的内容以便于……（通常用于表示为某人整理或简化信息）
words.ex: He will summarize for the class tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将为全班做总结。
words.en: To give a brief statement of the main points of something.

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.tr: phrase.  灭绝；逐渐消失
words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.tr: phrase. 崩溃；瓦解；破裂
words.ex: The old chair will fall apart if you sit on it.
words.ex_cn: 如果你坐在那把旧椅子上，它就会散架。
words.en: If something falls apart, it breaks into pieces because it is old or badly made.

words.tr: phrase. 扯下；拆卸
words.ex: He tore down the poster from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把海报从墙上扯了下来。
words.en: To tear down something means to destroy or remove it completely, especially a building or other structure.

words.tr: phrase. （船）搁浅；触礁；陷入困境
words.ex: The boat ran aground on the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 船在岩石上搁浅了。
words.en: To run onto a rock or into the shore, causing a ship to be stuck.

words.tr: phrase. 热身；变暖；使活跃起来
words.ex: He warms up before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前热身。
words.en: To prepare for physical exertion or a performance by exercising or practicing gently beforehand.

words.tr: phrase. 成行地展开；延长
words.ex: He string out the clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服成行地展开在绳子上晾干。
words.en: To extend or prolong something, typically a discussion or event, over a longer period of time than originally intended.

words.tr: phrase. 插嘴；打断；超车抢档
words.ex: He cut in while I was talking.
words.ex_cn: 我正在说话时，他插嘴了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking, or to move into a line of traffic by driving in front of someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出；突出；坚持到底；显眼
words.ex: The boy stuck out his tongue at the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩对老师吐了吐舌头。
words.en: If something sticks out, it extends beyond something else. If you stick out part of your body, you extend it away from your body.

words.tr: phrase. 付清；偿还（欠款）；缴清（应付款项）
words.ex: He must pay up before he leaves.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前必须付钱。
words.en: To pay a debt or an amount owed in full.

words.tr: phrase. 吹进来；忽然来访
words.ex: The wind will blow in from the sea tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚风会从海上吹来。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere suddenly or unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.tr: phrase. 能够
words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决困难的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability, power, or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 能够；有能力
words.ex: He is able to swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 他能游得很好。
words.en: To have the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到尴尬或难为情的
words.ex: He is embarrassed about his bad pronunciation.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的糟糕发音而感到尴尬。
words.en: To feel ashamed or self-conscious about something one has done.

words.tr: phrase. 根深蒂固于；深深植入于
words.en: Deeply fixed or established in a person's mind or character.

words.tr: phrase. 被与……整合；被与……结合（指事物相互融合或协调地组合在一起）
words.ex: The new app is integrated with the school system.
words.ex_cn: 这个新应用与学校系统整合在一起。
words.en: To be combined or joined with something else to form a single, unified system or entity.

words.tr: phrase. 对……抱有希望的；期望……
words.ex: He is hopeful of passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他希望通过考试。
words.en: To feel or show optimism about a future event or outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 参与；从事于
words.ex: He is engaged in writing a book.
words.ex_cn: 他正在写一本书。
words.en: To be involved in a particular activity or task.

words.tr: phrase. 对...好奇
words.ex: He is curious about how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他对植物如何生长感到好奇。
words.en: To have a strong desire to learn or know about something.

words.tr: phrase. 源于；根植于；起源于（某事物）
words.ex: His beliefs are rooted in tradition.
words.ex_cn: 他的信念源于传统。
words.en: To have a firm foundation or origin in something.

words.tr: 短语动词，以…著称；因…而著名
words.ex: He is notable for his excellent math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他因出色的数学能力而闻名。
words.en: To be worthy of attention or notice because of being unusual or excellent.

words.tr: phrase. 对…感兴趣
words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学感兴趣。
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.tr: phrase. 被应用于；被实施于；适用于
words.ex: This rule can be applied to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则可以应用于所有学生。
words.en: To be used or relevant in a particular situation or for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于；着迷于
words.ex: He is obsessed with video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: To be completely preoccupied with a particular thought or feeling, often to an unhealthy degree.

words.tr: phrase. 愿意做某事；乐意去做某事
words.ex_cn: 她愿意帮助你完成你的项目。
words.en: To be ready and eager to do something.

words.tr: adj. 与某事物不一致的；与某事物矛盾的
words.ex: His answer is inconsistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据不符。
words.en: To not be in agreement or harmony with something else.

words.tr: adj. 有可能做某事的；能够实现的
words.ex: It is possible to swim across the lake.
words.ex_cn: 游过这个湖是可能的。
words.en: To be able to happen or exist; to be feasible.

words.tr: phr. 对……感到敬畏；因……而惊叹
words.ex: She is awed by the big mountains.
words.ex_cn: 她被那些高山震撼了。
words.en: To feel great respect, wonder, or admiration for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 与……相关联；与……有相互关系
words.ex: The results of this study suggest that smoking is strongly correlated with lung cancer.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的结论表明，吸烟与肺癌有很强的相关性。
words.en: To have a mutual relationship or connection, in which one thing affects or depends on another.

words.tr: phrase. 很可能做某事；有倾向做某事
words.ex_cn: 他很可能通过考试。
words.en: If something is likely to happen, it is probable that it will happen.

words.tr: phrase. 害怕某物或某种情况；对……感到恐惧
words.ex: She is scared of spiders.
words.ex_cn: 她害怕蜘蛛。
words.en: To feel fear or anxiety about someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 遭受；暴露于...
words.ex_cn: 孩子应该从小接触好书。
words.en: To be in a situation where one is not protected from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 确信；承认
words.ex: He is convinced that math is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他确信数学很简单。
words.en: To be certain that something is true or that someone is telling the truth.

words.tr: phrase. 被视为；被认为是
words.ex: He is considered as one of the best teachers in the school.
words.ex_cn: 他被认为是学校里最好的老师之一。
words.en: To be thought of or regarded in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 适合…
words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这个派对。
words.en: To be appropriate or fitting for a particular purpose, person, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 对……来说很重要；对……有重要意义
words.ex: Exercise is important to our health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼对我们的健康很重要。
words.en: To be of great significance or value to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 被……分散注意力的；因……而分心的
words.ex_cn: 他被巨大的噪音分散了注意力。
words.en: To have one's attention drawn away from something by something else.

words.tr: phrase. 与…不相容的；与……对立
words.ex: This software may be incompatible with older operating systems.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件可能与旧的操作系统不兼容。
words.en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they do not suit each other or agree with each other.

words.tr: phrase. 对...负责
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 充满着
words.ex: The room is filled with laughter.
words.ex_cn: 房间里充满了笑声。
words.en: To have a lot of a particular quality or thing.

words.tr: v. 被授予……而感到荣幸；因……而受到尊敬
words.ex: He was honored with a gold medal for his courage.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢而被授予金牌。
words.en: To receive or be granted an honor, award, or recognition.

words.tr: phrase. 有资格做…；具备…的条件
words.ex_cn: 他有经验，所以有资格胜任这份工作。
words.en: To have the necessary skills, qualities, or knowledge to do a particular job or task.

words.tr: phrase. 不愿意做某事
words.ex: He is unwilling to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意打扫他的房间。
words.en: To not want to do something, often because it is unpleasant or you do not agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 伴同；伴随
words.ex: The song is accompanied by a guitar.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌由吉他伴奏。
words.en: To be accompanied by someone or something means to have them with you as a companion, escort, or accompaniment.

words.tr: v. 被归类为；被划分为
words.ex: He is classed as a top student.
words.ex_cn: 他被列为优秀学生。
words.en: To be categorized or classified within a particular group or type.

words.tr: phrase. 被打算用于；旨在为……而做或存在
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为初学者准备的。
words.en: If something is intended for a particular purpose, it has been planned or designed to fulfill that purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 被增强的；被强化的（通常指食物中添加了额外的营养成分，如维生素或矿物质）
words.ex: The milk is fortified with vitamin D.
words.ex_cn: 这种牛奶添加了维生素D。
words.en: To be strengthened or reinforced, often with additional materials or nutrients.

words.tr: phrase. 有…倾向的；易于…的
words.ex: He is liable to make mistakes when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，容易出错。
words.en: If someone or something is liable to something, they are likely to experience it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 被仿效；以…为模型；模仿
words.ex: The new school is modeled on the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这所新学校是以旧学校为模式建立的。
words.en: To be based on or imitate the structure of something else.

words.tr: phrase. 暴露于；受到
words.ex: He had exposure to new ideas at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校接触到了新思想。
words.en: The state of being exposed to something, especially something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 在……方面的技能；擅长于……
words.ex: He has skill in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决数学问题。
words.en: The ability or expertise to perform a specific task or activity effectively.

words.tr: 短语. ……的核心；……的中心；……的要害
words.ex: The park is the heart of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是城市的中心。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.tr: 短语. 一种……的方法；……的手段
words.ex: Bicycles are a means of getting to work.
words.ex_cn: 自行车是一种上班的方式。
words.en: A method, instrument, or way of achieving something; a tool or system used for a particular purpose.

words.tr: 短语. ...的一部分
words.ex: This book is a part of the series.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是这套书的一部分。
words.en: A component, element, or portion that constitutes a larger whole.

words.tr: 短语，表示……的来源；……的原因
words.ex: Water is a source of life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命之源。
words.en: Something that originates or provides something else.

words.tr: 短语. 大量的；各种各样的（用于描述种类繁多的事物）
words.ex: The museum has a vast array of artifacts from ancient civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆有大量来自古代文明的文物。
words.en: A large and varied collection or range of something.

words.tr: n. ……的等价物；相当于……的东西
words.ex: This book is the equivalent of two hours of class.
words.ex_cn: 这本书相当于两小时的课程。
words.en: Something that is equal in value, amount, function, or meaning to another thing.

words.tr: phrase. 对…的痴迷；对…的执念；对…的过度关注
words.ex: He has an obsession with video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏着迷。
words.en: An obsession with something is a state in which you think about it all the time and find it hard to think about anything else.

words.tr: det. 一堆，许多（用于修饰不可数或可数名词，常带有贬义或强调数量多）
words.ex: There are a piles of dirty clothes on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上堆着一大堆脏衣服。
words.en: A large quantity or number of things, often piled or stacked together.

words.tr: phrase. 多种的；各种各样的
words.ex: He eats a variety of fruits every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃各种各样的水果。
words.en: A number or range of things of the same general class that are different or distinct in character or quality.

words.tr: 短语. 一定数量的；一些（用于不可数名词前）
words.ex: An amount of money was donated to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 许多钱被捐赠给了慈善机构。
words.en: A quantity of something, often used to indicate a specific or unspecified measure of a substance, item, or concept.

words.tr: phrase. 一组；一副；一套
words.ex: He has a set of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他书架上有一套书。
words.en: A group of similar things that belong together or are used together.

words.tr: 短语动词. 反对……开展运动；为反对……而进行宣传或斗争
words.ex: They started a campaign against pollution.
words.ex_cn: 他们发起了反对污染的运动。
words.en: To actively oppose or argue against a particular cause or candidate.

words.tr: phrase. 缺少...
words.ex: There is a shortage of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 村里缺乏干净的水。
words.en: A situation where there is not enough of something needed.

words.tr: phrase. 量化分析师所评估的价值量；量化价值单位
words.ex: He has a quant's worth of data for his research.
words.ex_cn: 他为研究收集了大量数据。
words.en: A significant amount of something, often implying value or quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 对……至关重要的；是……的核心的
words.ex: Water is central to life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: Being central to something means that it is essential or of great importance to it.

words.tr: phrase. 大多数
words.ex: The majority of students like math.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢数学。
words.en: The phrase 'the majority of' is used to refer to the greater part or number of something. It implies more than half of a total amount or number.

words.tr: 短语. 一些……的碎片；一部分……
words.ex: There are bits of paper on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上有一些纸片。
words.en: Small pieces or amounts of something.

words.tr: 短语. 某事物的一部分；某种成分
words.ex: There's an element of truth in what he says.
words.ex_cn: 他说的话中有一点真实性。
words.en: A small part or component of something.

words.tr: phrase. 受...支配；沉迷于
words.ex: He is a slave to his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他被手机奴役了。
words.en: A person who is completely controlled by or devoted to something, often to the point of losing their freedom or independence.

words.tr: 短语。对…有价值；对…有意义
words.ex: He gives great value to family time.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视家庭时光。
words.en: To consider something important or beneficial to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 与此相反；正相反
words.ex: He says he likes quiet, on the contrary, he always listens to loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢安静，相反，他总是听大声的音乐。
words.en: You use 'on the contrary' when you are contradicting what has just been said or implied, or making a contrast between two things.

words.tr: phrase. 面对……的可能性时；一想到……就
words.ex: He felt nervous at the prospect of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 一想到要当众发言，他就感到紧张。
words.en: When thinking about or anticipating a future event, especially one that causes excitement or anxiety.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协力；和...一起
words.ex: He uses a calculator in conjunction with paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器和纸一起计算。
words.en: Together with; in combination or coordination with.

words.tr: phrase. 在损害...的情况下
words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但牺牲了自己的健康。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is done in a way that harms them or is unfair to them.

words.tr: 短语 为了做某事；以便做某事
words.ex: He studies hard in order to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了通过考试。
words.en: with the aim or purpose of doing something

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 偏离目标的；不准确的；离题的；错误的
words.ex: His predictions were off the mark.
words.ex_cn: 他的预测不准确。
words.en: If something is off the mark, it is incorrect or inaccurate.

words.tr: phrase. 例如；比如
words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.tr: 短语. 在……岁时
words.ex: He started school at the age of six.
words.ex_cn: 他六岁时开始上学。
words.en: Used to indicate the specific age at which something happens or someone does something.

words.tr: phrase. 长度上
words.ex: The rope is five meters in length.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子长五米。
words.en: used to describe the measurement of something from one end to the other

words.tr: phrase. 由于，作为...的结果
words.ex: He succeeded as the result of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他由于努力工作而成功。
words.en: because of something that has happened

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.tr: prep. 试图做某事；为了尝试做某事
words.ex: He woke up early in attempt to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶公交车。
words.en: With the intention or purpose of achieving a specific action or outcome.

words.tr: phrase. /prep. phr. 执政的；当权的；掌权的
words.ex: The party has been in power for over a decade.
words.ex_cn: 这个政党已经掌权超过十年。
words.en: Holding a position of authority or control, especially in government.

words.tr: phrase. 口口相传地；通过口头传播
words.ex: The news spread by word of mouth.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息是通过口头传播的。
words.en: If something is communicated or spreads by word of mouth, it is passed from one person to another in conversation.

words.tr: phrase. 在实践中；实际上
words.ex: He knows the rules, but in practice, he forgets them.
words.ex_cn: 他知道这些规则，但在实践中却忘了。
words.en: Used to say what actually happens or is done, especially when this is different from what is expected or supposed to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 与……合作；与……合伙；与……建立伙伴关系
words.ex: The company is working in partnership with local schools to improve education.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在与当地学校合作以改善教育。
words.en: In collaboration or cooperation with someone or something.

words.tr: prep. 致敬；向……表示敬意
words.ex: They planted trees in tribute to the fallen heroes.
words.ex_cn: 他们种树以纪念阵亡的英雄。
words.en: As a way of showing respect or admiration for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 第一次
words.ex: He smiled for the first time today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天第一次笑了。
words.en: If something happens for the first time, it has never happened before.

words.tr: phrase. 例如
words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: I agree with you to an extent, but I think there are other factors to consider.
words.ex_cn: 我在某种程度上同意你，但我认为还有其他因素需要考虑。
words.en: To a certain degree or in a certain measure; somewhat but not entirely.

words.tr: phrase. 曾经；同时；一度
words.ex: At one time, he played soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 曾经，他每天踢足球。
words.en: If something was the case at one time, it was the case during a particular period in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 供应的；可获得的；特价出售的；正在出售的
words.ex: There are many discounts on offer this week.
words.ex_cn: 本周有很多折扣优惠。
words.en: If something is on offer, it is available for sale or is being provided.

words.tr: phrase. 已经完成或经历过的；已消化吸收的（尤指经验或成就）
words.ex: Learning to ride a bike is under the belt now.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车已经学会了。
words.en: Gained or achieved, especially as experience or qualification.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.tr: 短语. 以……的速率；以……的速度
words.ex: The car was moving at a rate of 60 miles per hour.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以每小时60英里的速度行驶。
words.en: Used to indicate the speed or ratio at which something happens or changes.

words.tr: phrase. 以……的速率；按……的速度
words.ex: He runs at the rate of ten kilometers per hour.
words.ex_cn: 他以每小时十公里的速度跑步。
words.en: Used to indicate the speed or frequency at which something happens or is done.

words.tr: phrase. 与…磋商；在征询…意见的情况下
words.ex: He made the decision in consultation with his doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他与医生商量后做出了决定。
words.en: After discussing with someone or a group to reach a decision or come up with a plan.

words.tr: prep. 在……语境中；在……背景下；在……情况下
words.ex: He explained the word in the real context.
words.ex_cn: 他在实际情境中解释了这个词。
words.en: Within the framework or circumstances of a particular subject or situation.

words.tr: verb phrase. 允许某人做某事
words.ex: The teacher allows students to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师允许学生提问。
words.en: To permit someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事；力争达成某事
words.ex: He strives to do his best every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都努力做到最好。
words.en: To make great efforts to achieve or obtain something.

words.tr: phrase. 倾向于做某事；往往会做某事
words.ex: Children tend to play outside after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后喜欢在外面玩。
words.en: If someone tends to do something, they usually do it or are likely to do it.

words.tr: 短语动词，建议做某事
words.ex: He advises doing exercise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他建议每天锻炼。
words.en: To recommend or suggest that someone do something.

words.tr: phrase. 开始做某事
words.ex: He starts doing his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: To begin an activity or process.

words.tr: v. 花费时间做某事
words.ex: He spends time reading books every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上花时间读书。
words.en: To use a period of time for a particular activity.

words.tr: v. 向某人透露某事；把某事告诉某人
words.ex: He revealed the secret to his best friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密告诉了他最好的朋友。
words.en: To make known or disclose information to someone.

words.tr: 使某人做某事
words.ex: The loud noise caused him to cover his ears.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他捂住了耳朵。
words.en: To make someone do something; to prompt or compel an action.

words.tr: phrase. 开始做某事
words.ex: He begins to do his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: begin to do sth

words.tr: 动词短语，帮助某人做某事
words.uk: hɛlp sʌm wʌn duː sʌm θɪŋ
words.us: hɛlp sʌm wʌn du sʌm θɪŋ
words.ex: I help my brother do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 我帮弟弟做作业。
words.en: To assist someone in performing an action.

words.tr: 短语动词，意为‘帮助某人做某事’，其中‘sb’代表某人，‘sth’代表某事。例如：She helped me to clean the room.（她帮我打扫房间。）
words.ex: He helps his sister to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助他妹妹打扫房间。
words.en: To assist someone in performing a task or activity.

words.tr: 短语动词，表示帮助做某事
words.ex: Can you help me do the homework?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我做作业吗？
words.en: To assist someone in performing a task or activity.

words.tr: v. 需要（被）做某事；要求某事被完成（用主动形式表达被动含义，相当于 require to be done）
words.ex: The job requires working late.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要加班。
words.en: To make something necessary or obligatory.

words.tr: phr. 使某事物持续处于某种动作或状态；让某事继续进行
words.ex: He keeps the machine running all night.
words.ex_cn: 他让机器整晚运转。
words.en: To cause something to continue in a particular state or action.

words.tr: phr. 使某人…（后接动词原形或形容词，表示“让某人做某事/处于某种状态”）
words.ex: The loud music made her angry.
words.ex_cn: 大声的音乐让她生气了。
words.en: To cause someone to be or become something.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人做某事；迫使某人做某事
words.ex: The teacher makes the student clean the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生打扫教室。
words.en: To cause someone to perform a specific action.

words.tr: phrase. 未能做某事；没有成功完成某事
words.ex: He fails to do his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都未能完成作业。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or you do not succeed in doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 更喜欢做某事；宁愿做某事
words.ex: I prefer to walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢走路去学校。
words.en: To like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than something else because you like it better.

words.tr: v. 向某人传达某事；将某事通知某人
words.ex: He communicated the news to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把消息告诉了他的朋友。
words.en: To share information or ideas with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人交流；与某人沟通
words.ex: I can communicate with my friend in English.
words.ex_cn: 我能用英语和我的朋友交流。
words.en: To exchange information or ideas with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做某事；持续不断地做某事
words.ex: He keeps asking the same question.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地问同一个问题。
words.en: To continue performing a particular action or activity.

words.tr: v. 看见……正在做某事（表示动作正在进行）
words.ex: I see him playing soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我每天下午都看见他在踢足球。
words.en: To observe someone or something in the process of doing something.

words.tr: v. 看到……做某事（表示目睹某人做某事的全过程）
words.ex: I see him walk to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上看见他走路去学校。
words.en: To observe someone performing an action.

words.tr: v. 将某物与另一物进行比较，以找出相似之处或差异
words.ex: He compares apples with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果和橙子做比较。
words.en: To examine the similarities or differences between two or more things.

words.tr: phr. 使某人对某事做好准备；让某人为某事做好准备
words.ex: The teacher prepares the students for the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师为学生准备考试。
words.en: To help someone become ready or fit for a particular situation or event.

words.tr: phr. 为某事做准备；为某事预备
words.ex: He prepares for the test every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上为考试做准备。
words.en: To make arrangements or get ready for something that is going to happen.

words.tr: 短语动词. 鼓励某人做某事
words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: To give someone support, confidence, or hope to do something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 选择做某事
words.ex: He choose to do homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他选择晚饭后做作业。
words.en: To decide to do something, especially when you have different options available.

words.tr: phr. 用某物替换某物；以某物取代某物
words.ex: He will replace the old chair with a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他将用一把新椅子替换旧椅子。
words.en: To take the place of something or someone, often as a substitute.

words.tr: phr. 用某物取代某物
words.ex: He replaced the old chair by a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把新椅子替换了旧椅子。
words.en: To take the place of something or someone, often as a substitute.

words.tr: phrase. 似乎做某事；看起来好像在做某事
words.ex: He seems to know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎知道答案。
words.en: to appear to be or do something, especially when this is not true or certain

words.tr: phrase. 块状太阳（非正式或诗意表达，指太阳被云层遮挡后呈现成一团模糊光斑的景象）
words.ex: The lump sun rose slowly over the hill.
words.ex_cn: 那颗巨大的太阳缓缓从山后升起。
words.en: A common misspelling of 'lump sum,' meaning a single payment of money.

words.tr: phrase. 心理健康；精神状态
words.ex: He cares about his mental health every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很关心自己的心理健康。
words.en: Mental health refers to the state of one's psychological and emotional well-being.

words.tr: phrase. 电影拍摄场地
words.ex: The actors arrived at the film set early.
words.ex_cn: 演员们早早到达了电影拍摄现场。
words.en: A film set is the location where a movie is filmed, including all the constructed scenery and props.

words.tr: phrase. 门诊部；门诊诊所
words.ex: He visits the outpatient clinics every week for check-ups.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去门诊诊所做检查。
words.en: Medical facilities where patients receive treatment without being admitted to a hospital.

words.tr: phrase. 应激反应；压力反应（指身体或心理对压力源产生的生理或心理反应）
words.ex: The body's stress response can be triggered by various factors.
words.ex_cn: 身体的应激反应可以由多种因素触发。
words.en: The reaction of the body to any demand for change, challenge, or threat, which can be physical, mental, or emotional.

words.tr: phrase. 一层无关偏见的面纱；指掩盖真相或干扰判断的不相关偏见
words.ex: A veil of extraneous prejudice hides the truth.
words.ex_cn: 一层无关的偏见遮蔽了真相。
words.en: A covering or layer of irrelevant or biased opinions that obscure the truth.

words.tr: phrase. 高姿态；鲜明的姿态
words.ex: He is a high profile celebrity who always appears on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位高调的名人，经常在电视上出现。
words.en: A high profile person or event is one that is known about by a lot of people and receives a lot of attention from the public or the media.

words.tr: phrase. 免疫系统
words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.tr: n. 言语治疗师；语言治疗师（帮助有言语或语言障碍的人进行康复训练的专业人员）
words.ex: The speech therapist helps children talk clearly.
words.ex_cn: 语言治疗师帮助孩子清晰地说话。
words.en: A medical professional who helps people with speech, language, or voice problems.

words.tr: phrase. 音乐治疗师；使用音乐手段进行心理或生理治疗的专业人员
words.ex: The music therapist plays guitar to help patients feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 音乐治疗师弹吉他帮助患者感到平静。
words.en: A professional who uses music to address physical, emotional, cognitive, and social needs of individuals.

words.tr: n. 艺术治疗师；运用艺术创作方式帮助患者表达情感、缓解心理问题的专业治疗人员
words.ex: She works as an art therapist for children.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名儿童艺术治疗师。
words.en: A practitioner who uses art-making processes to support mental, emotional, and physical well-being.

words.tr: n. 辅助疗法治疗师；指从事补充或辅助医学治疗的专业人员，如针灸、按摩、草药疗法等
words.ex: The complemental therapist uses aromatherapy to help patients relax.
words.ex_cn: 辅助疗法治疗师使用芳香疗法帮助患者放松。
words.en: A healthcare provider who uses non-mainstream therapies, such as acupuncture or herbal medicine, alongside conventional treatments.

words.tr: adj. + n. 健康的治疗师；指身心状态良好的从事心理或身体治疗的专业人员
words.ex: She is a healthy therapist who helps patients feel better.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位健康的治疗师，帮助患者感觉更好。
words.en: A therapist who focuses on promoting overall wellness and prevention, rather than treating specific illnesses or disorders.

words.tr: phrase. 数量级；指数级差异；用于描述数值相差10倍的倍数关系
words.ex: The new computer is orders of magnitude faster than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这台新电脑比旧电脑快好几个数量级。
words.en: A scale used to describe the relative size or intensity of something, often in factors of ten (e.g., 10, 100, 1000).

words.tr: phrase. 身体健康；身体安康
words.ex: He eats well and exercises to improve his physical wellbeing.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食健康并锻炼以改善身体健康。
words.en: The state of being physically healthy and free from illness or injury, encompassing aspects like fitness, nutrition, and rest.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食习惯
words.ex: He changed his dietary habit to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了饮食习惯，多吃蔬菜。
words.en: Dietary habit refers to the habitual decisions an individual or culture makes when choosing what foods to eat.

words.tr: n. 污染物质；造成污染的材料
words.ex: The factory is contaminating material with toxic chemicals.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用有毒化学品污染材料。
words.en: A substance or object that can introduce harmful substances or organisms, posing a risk to health or the environment.

words.tr: n. 睡眠模式；睡眠规律
words.ex: He changed his sleeping pattern to feel more rested.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了睡眠模式，以便感觉更休息。
words.en: The habitual or regular pattern of sleep and wakefulness, including timing, duration, and quality.

words.tr: phrase. 回复率；有效率
words.ex: The response rate was low in the survey.
words.ex_cn: 调查的回复率很低。
words.en: The proportion of people who respond to a survey, advertisement, or other form of communication.

words.tr: phrase. 珊瑚礁的形成；珊瑚结构的发育过程
words.ex: Coral formation takes many years to grow.
words.ex_cn: 珊瑚的形成需要很多年才能生长。
words.en: A structure built by coral polyps, typically found in warm, shallow seas, consisting of calcium carbonate skeletons that form reefs or atolls.

words.tr: n. 因果关系，指一个事件（原因）导致另一个事件（结果）发生的关系
words.ex: The rain caused a flood, showing a cause and effect relationship.
words.ex_cn: 下雨导致了洪水，这显示了因果关系。
words.en: A logical connection where one event (the cause) leads to another event (the effect).
